claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: ZM-323881 is a potent and selective VEGFR2 (KDR) inhibitor that is expected to be largely inactive as a direct cytotoxic agent against cancer cell lines at 2.5 uM, since VEGFR2 is not a major driver of proliferation in most cancer cell lines in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
